title: Access to root SSH Key Material
description: Detects /root/.ssh (private keys, authorized_keys) being read by a shell, interpreter, or exfil tool. MHBench's audit.rules watch this path with -p rwa. sshd/ssh/scp/ssh-keygen use key material legitimately, so instead of excluding them we positively require the reader to be a tool used to steal or stage the key (cat/cp/scp-of-the-file/base64/an interpreter...).
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Configuration management reading authorized_keys via a shell wrapper.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE key='rootkey' AND ((exe LIKE '%/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tac' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/less' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/more' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/head' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tail' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/od' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/xxd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/hexdump' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/base64' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/base32' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/strings' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/cp' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/awk' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sed' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/vi' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/vim' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/nano' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/nc' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/ncat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/netcat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/socat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/rsync' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tar' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/busybox' ESCAPE '\') OR (exe LIKE '%/python%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/perl%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/ruby%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/php%' ESCAPE '\'))

title: Access to /etc/shadow (Credential Dumping)
description: Detects /etc/shadow (or /etc/gshadow) being read by a shell, interpreter, or file-reading / exfil tool. MHBench's audit.rules watch these paths with -p rwa, capturing the read. Rather than trying to exclude the many auth/system daemons that legitimately touch shadow (sshd, systemd, systemd-logind, sudo, cron, unix_chkpwd, getcap, ls...), we positively require the reader to be a tool an operator/agent would use to dump the hashes.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: A backup/exfil-lookalike tool (tar/rsync of the whole filesystem) legitimately including /etc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (key='etcshadow' OR key='etcgshadow') AND ((exe LIKE '%/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tac' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/less' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/more' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/head' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tail' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/nl' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/od' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/xxd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/hexdump' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/base64' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/base32' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/strings' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/cp' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/egrep' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/awk' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/gawk' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sed' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/cut' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/vi' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/vim' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/view' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/nano' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/nc' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/ncat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/netcat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/socat' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/scp' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/rsync' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/tar' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/ksh' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/busybox' ESCAPE '\') OR (exe LIKE '%/python%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/perl%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/ruby%' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/php%' ESCAPE '\'))

title: eBPF Program Load
description: Detects the bpf() syscall loading eBPF programs. eBPF can hook syscalls, hide processes/files, and sniff traffic from kernel context, making it a building block for modern Linux rootkits and for tampering with security telemetry.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Observability/EDR agents, systemd, and networking (tc/XDP) legitimately load eBPF. Baseline first.

title: Timestomping via utime Syscalls
description: Detects use of utimensat/utimes/futimesat to alter a file's access/modification timestamps — timestomping, an anti-forensics technique used to make malicious files blend in with surrounding system files and defeat timeline analysis.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Archive extraction (tar -p), rsync -a, and cp -p during legitimate admin/build activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE key LIKE 'file\_timestomp' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT (exe LIKE '%/systemd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/apparmor\_parser' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/unsquashfs' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/mksquashfs' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dpkg' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dpkg-deb' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/snap' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/snapd' ESCAPE '\'))

title: Failed Outbound Connection (Scanning / Lateral Movement Probe)
description: Detects failed connect() syscalls (key network_connect_fail). A refused or timed-out connect is direct evidence of attempted-but-failed lateral movement or network service discovery — the attacker probing hosts/ports that are closed or filtered. High volume by nature; treat a burst from one process/host as a scan rather than each event individually.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Application clients retrying a briefly-unavailable dependency during the attack window.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE key LIKE 'network\_connect\_fail' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT (exe LIKE '%/splunkd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/unix\_chkpwd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sshd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sshd-session' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sshd-auth' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sftp-server' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/logrotate' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/cron' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/crond' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd-tmpfiles' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd-logind' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd-user-runtime-dir' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/getent' ESCAPE '\'))

title: Anonymous In-Memory File Creation (memfd_create)
description: Detects memfd_create, which allocates an anonymous in-memory file. Combined with fexecve it lets a binary run entirely from memory without ever touching disk — a common fileless / reflective-loading evasion. Rarely used by benign software.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: A few language runtimes/loaders use memfd_create; baseline per image before alerting.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE key LIKE 'anon\_file\_create' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT exe LIKE '%/systemd' ESCAPE '\')

title: Kernel Module Load
description: Detects init_module/finit_module (key modules) loading a kernel module. MHBench's audit.rules capture this for every actor (the auid filter was removed), so a daemon-context agent loading a module — a classic rootkit/persistence primitive — is caught.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Legitimate driver/module loading at boot or on hardware/filesystem changes.

title: Failed Privilege Change (setuid/setgid/capset)
description: Detects a FAILED setuid/setgid/setresuid/capset syscall (key priv_change, success=no). Successful privilege changes happen constantly (sudo, su, login), but a failed one is a strong escalation signal — a process attempting to change credentials it is not permitted to, e.g. a failing exploit or an agent probing for a privilege it lacks.
author: MHBench detection harness
falsepositives: Residual privilege-dropping daemons not in the exclusion list under an unexpected uid map.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (key LIKE 'priv\_change' ESCAPE '\' AND success='no') AND (NOT (exe LIKE '%/sshd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sshd-auth' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sshd-session' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/su' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/sudo' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/login' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/agetty' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/systemd-logind' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/unix\_chkpwd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/cron' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/crond' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/polkitd' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/dbus-daemon' ESCAPE '\' OR exe LIKE '%/gdm-session-worker' ESCAPE '\'))
